svg.title: Aymaan Mirza, Electrical Engineering at McMaster.
svg.text: Third-year Electrical Engineering student at McMaster University, building toward a career
in ASIC/FPGA design and digital hardware.
with CDC, FIFO design, low-power techniques and formal verification along the way
Verilog / SystemVerilog, from syntax to complex systems
Timing analysis: STA concepts, analysis and fixes
Logic synthesis: RTL to gate-level netlist
